name: Fort George
text: Fort George was the name of five different forts in what is now the state of New York.

real.title: A view of Fort George with the city of New York, from the SW.jpg

depictions.name: Fort George
depictions.text: Fort Amsterdam Fort George was a military location in southern New York City. It was known by various names through its lifetime, including Fort Amsterdam, Fort James, Fort William, and Fort Anne; the latter three were names of English and British monarchs.
